note: Attacker-controlled input Data is passed to the SPSS commands parser
Parser matches a quoted string from input; str_start points into the input buffer, str_len is the length of the quoted content
Quoted string content is copied into buf[1024] via readstat_copy_quoted
Off-by-one: when str_len >= buf_len, this_len is set to buf_len instead of buf_len-1, allowing one extra iteration
After copying buf_len bytes into buf[0..buf_len-1], j == buf_len, so null terminator is written at buf[buf_len], one byte past the buffer
